title: Checkpointed execution, semantic validation and replay
summary: Implemented transaction-like execution safeguards and reproducible engineering artifacts for agent-driven configuration.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2026-08-28. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Implemented checkpointed execution, rollback, semantic readback and postconditions for interconnect plans.
Produced reproducible Configuration Engine Python exports, derived iYML artifacts and replay validation.
A historical bounded rollback evaluation recorded exact equality of the restored iYML configuration hash.
Validated durable plan receipts against canonical authority, consecutive mutation batches and semantic continuity, rejecting phase gaps or stale continuation evidence.
Implemented exact committed-phase retries that return validated receipt evidence without repeating Configuration Engine mutations.

notes: The hash equality is a recorded historical result, not a newly executed test; rollback is distinct from backend fallback and runtime compatibility.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
